data.rationale: The proposal has the right overall procedure and order (npm search, package page, GitHub repo, Releases, then a note), but it lists derived outputs (version, downloads, stars, issues, date) as parameters when only the package name varies. It also leaves out the "New note" click, the Enter key press, the exact note format, and the step of closing the GitHub tab or going back, and it wrongly says stars and issues are read on the Releases page. A browser automation could not be built from this spec alone.
